title: Oath and Garden
author: Theo Ravensworth
blurb: Orsen Hartwell, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
